scope: Proposition 6.5 (Bounds before regularity) of the manuscript “Spacetime Penrose inequalities: enclosing area, charge, and rigidity” (preprints/Spacetime-Penrose-inequalities-enclosing-area-charge-and-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 794bf524061c4b36), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 44. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix the prepared data and ϵ > 0. There are n0 and Rmin(n) → ∞ such that, for each fixed n ≥ n0 and every R ≥ Rmin(n), all smooth solutions of the four-stage homotopy with t ≥ −ϵ satisfy (6.27) |h| ≤ C0, |f| ≤ C0/τ, −ϵ ≤ t ≤ Z ≤ C(n), |∇f| ≤ C(n). The constants are uniform in R and in the homotopy parameter. They include putative floor- contact solutions, which are then excluded by Proposition 5.9. The fixed signed slopes, the third-stage upper slopes, and the polynomial trace estimates are those of Lemmas 6.2 and 6.3.
